Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing a person to apply for a work permit for the employment of minors without completing a new master application under certain circumstances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the submission of new master applications bypersons seeking work permits for the employment of minors; and addinga new section to chapter 19.02 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person seeking a work permit for the employment of minors underRCW 49.12.121 is not required to complete an entirely new masterapplication if there are no changes to any other information submittedon the most recent master application. The person need only completethe parts of a new master application that identify the employerseeking the minor work permit, including address and contactinformation, and that indicate the employer plans to employ one or moreminors, the duties to be performed by minors, and the estimated numberof hours to be worked by minors.
